entry.title: AvaloniaUI/Avalonia - Releases - 2026-04-07
entry.content:
12.0.0

General

Read our release blog post for more information about Avalonia 12!

Useful links:

  • Website
  • Documentation
  • v12 breaking changes

What's Changed

Changes since 12.0.0-rc2

  • CompositionAnimation fixes by @zxbmmmmmmmmm in #20936
